checks.text: 12    What We Need From You & Acceptance

Thank you for the brief. You asked us to strengthen Gladwyn's professional presence on LinkedIn, position him as a thought leader in the investment and entrepreneurship ecosystem, and keep his content aligned with his role as CEO and E Squared's broader positioning. You also asked for options depending on how much engagement management is included.

Our answer is a three-level service built around the same foundation: two posts a month in Gladwyn's own voice, designed and published, a profile audit and optimisation at the start, and a monthly report. The levels differ in how much active engagement they include, from a weekly review with draft replies (Option 1), through daily monitoring, proactive comments and stakeholder outreach (Option 2), to a fuller programme with more content, long-form pieces and fresh imagery (Option 3).

We recommend Option 2. A CEO's LinkedIn presence is built as much in other people's comments and conversations as in his own posts, and Option 2 is the level at which that engagement is managed properly while the monthly publishing stays at the two posts you asked for.

The points below come from public reporting and E Squared's own communications, and we would confirm them with your team before using them in any content. We have not yet seen Gladwyn's current LinkedIn profile or analytics, so the audit in the first weeks will establish the starting point.
The aim is a presence that reads as Gladwyn's own: a thoughtful investor and former operator who speaks plainly about capital, founders and responsible growth. We propose five content pillars.
How We Keep the Voice His Own
A 90-minute voice workshop and a written voice guide at the start, covering his phrases, tone and topics he avoids.
Every post is drafted from his own ideas, interviews and published words, and approved by him before it is published.
A first-person voice, plain language and a clear point of view, avoiding corporate boilerplate.
Coordination with E Squared's company page so that his posts complement the organisation's content rather than repeat it.

Executive Leadership Magazine or SME Entrepreneur Magazine profile, column or SME PowerTalk podcast guest appearance, labelled as partner content where applicable, which also supplies material for LinkedIn.
A short video series of two to three minutes with Gladwyn on founder and investor topics.
Support for E Squared's company page, so the CEO and company presence work together.
Speaker-profile and event-promotion support for conferences where Gladwyn is a speaker.
All fees exclude VAT at 15%. The one-off onboarding fee in Section 6 applies to every option.

We set the baseline in the first month and agree targets once we know where the profile stands. We do not promise a number of followers or views, because LinkedIn's reach depends on many factors and on Gladwyn's own participation.

From January 2027 the programme follows the monthly cycle in Section 7, with a quarterly strategy review in Options 2 and 3. If E Squared signs later than 6 November, the dates move back by the same number of days.
Term and payment. A six-month minimum term, then month to month with 30 days' notice. Monthly fees are billed in advance, and the one-off fee is invoiced on signature. Fees are reviewed annually.
Validity. Valid until Friday, 27 November 2026. Fees exclude VAT at 15%.

Client inputs. Gladwyn or his office approves content within 48 hours, provides input for the monthly calendar and joins a short call each quarter. Delays in approval affect the posting schedule but not the fees.
Additional work. Extra posts above the plan are R2,150 each (R1,500 writing and R650 design). Additional comments, outreach and research are billed at R750 per hour by agreement.
Exclusions. Paid LinkedIn advertising and its media spend, LinkedIn Premium or Sales Navigator licences, travel, and external photography and video outside the Option 3 sessions.
No guarantees. We do not guarantee follower numbers, impressions, leads or any specific outcome.
Ownership. E Squared owns the content we produce for Gladwyn once paid. We may cite the work in our portfolio only with E Squared's written approval.
Confidentiality. We keep information about E Squared and its portfolio confidential and sign a confidentiality agreement on request.

E Squared Investments is an impact investment fund that backs responsible entrepreneurs across the journey: pre-seed programmes, early-stage investment, co-investment, fund partnerships, social entrepreneurship and venture philanthropy. It backs ventures founded by Allan Gray Fellows and is a strategic partner to Allan & Gill Gray Philanthropies.

R316m invested in 2025 and R1.34bn across 227 businesses since inception; 37,756 jobs created, supported and beneficiated; 92% of 2025 investment value directed to Black beneficiaries and 62% to Black women-owned businesses; 16% fair market value growth in the venture portfolio and R31m realised from partial exits in 2025.

CEO since September 2023. Previously a General Partner at Kingson Capital, where he led post-investment management; earlier roles at Anglo American's Zimele enterprise and supplier development arm and on the senior executive team at CCI South Africa; founder of a peer-to-peer lending fintech platform; degrees from Wits and Wits Business School.

Scaling with purpose; responsible entrepreneurship, meaning running a successful business while having a positive impact on society; patient, long-term capital; and the view that financial performance and social impact are mutually reinforcing.

Gladwyn has a credible, distinctive story and real numbers behind it. LinkedIn is where founders, co-investors, fund managers, corporates and policymakers in his ecosystem form impressions, and a consistent, personal voice there strengthens trust in E Squared.

Publishing and engagement both need some form of access to Gladwyn's account. LinkedIn's terms generally expect individuals to keep their own login details private, so we recommend an arrangement that does not involve sharing his password, for example posting and replying from our approved drafts through his office, or another method that E Squared's IT and compliance team approves. We will agree the method in onboarding. If direct access is not possible, we supply ready-to-post packs and draft replies, and the fees stay the same.

Transformation, race, gender and politics are discussed with care and with E Squared's approval, in line with the firm's published positions.
Personal information about people he engages with is handled in line with POPIA and is not shared or sold.
We monitor for negative or sensitive comments and escalate promptly, and we disclose other clients that could create a conflict.
